slides.title: I typed the same CV into *50* websites
slides.sub: As a fresh 3rd Officer with no contract in rank.

slides.title: No contract in rank
slides.body: Fresh 3rd Officer licence, no ship yet. Every agency wanted its own online form.

slides.title: Same details, 50 times
slides.body: Name, rank, certificates, sea service. Typed by hand into about 50 agency websites.

slides.title: A weak CV, no model
slides.body: Nobody showed me what a good seafarer CV looks like. Mine was weak, and I didn't know it.

slides.title: So I built *Ocean Link*
slides.body: Snap your certificates once, track your sea time, get a clean CV in one tap. Built by a 2nd Officer, still at sea.

slides.question: How many agency forms have you filled in?
slides.line: Built at sea by a serving 2nd Officer.
